quest.title: Uninvited Guests
quest.description: Many unexpected things have happened on this mountain. A mysterious hidden camp, suddenly-appearing thieves, uninvited enemies... This sword seems to have brought you into the thick of all this weirdness. So long as it remains in your hands, trouble will always follow in its wake — with such troubles including those who have come to take the sword, and new monsters heretofore unseen.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon: Act IV
chapter.title: Uninvited Guests

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo! We're baaaack!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It seems that he's not here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is he out investigating something? Or maybe he went to make some mysterious drawings?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ah! It's you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't Sucrose! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I'm in the final stage of my research. I have five hours and twenty-six minutes of leisure time today.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: So I came here looking for you to inquire about previously discussed matters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You tell time very accurately! Are you a human clock?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No, no, it's nothing worth your praise. You're too kind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That wasn't a compliment...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: C—Can I ask you a question, Traveler? I made a request regarding investigating Mr. Albedo's secret. Have you made any progress?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, but it's been over a week since we talked about it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I thought you'd forgotten about it.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: What...!?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: O—Over a week? I clearly... Ah!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I've been so absorbed in my research. That matter of ours had completely slipped my mind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How can your sense of time be so strong and so weak at the same time...?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: S—So! Do you know what it is?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: That's great. Could you tell me?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you think, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Telling her shouldn't really matter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She can take a look, too. Just no touching...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Wait. What are you talking about?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: What's this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a super powerful sword. Don't touch it with your bare hands!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Uh... This is...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah! Th—This is... I've never seen...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, look all you want! Not sure why, but even Paimon feels a strange sense of achievement.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Astounding! It's the first time I've heard of such a mysterious weapon.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I can faintly feel the power coursing through the sword... It's like a living creature.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it such a distinct feeling?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: This may be due to my alchemist training.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I don't dare to say anything for sure, but the "flow" of power is very noticeable. Although this description isn't the most precise... N—Normally, I wouldn't define things like that.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Please, believe me! I don't usually use such ambiguous terms!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, we got it.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Traveler, could you use this sword in battle?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'd like to learn more about it, but I'm unable to use it myself. I can only ask for your assistance.

choices.text: Let's keep a low profile. We can't let Albedo know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's look around for the right spot!

choices.text: We should find a place hidden from view.
This is the answer you seek.

talks.objective: Head to the monster habitat to test the sword

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: U—Ugh... Argh...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: M—Mr. Pallad!?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: You still haven't gone back?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that the hotheaded adventurer from Mondstadt? Did he come here with Cyrus to explore the Snowy Mountain, too?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I'm f—f—f—freezing, ACHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Have you been here since I rescued you from the snow pit!?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I wanted to leave, b—but I got lost. I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: U—Ugh... It's so c—cold that I c—can't move...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Mr. Pallad, a trip to this mountain requires solid preparation. You shouldn't have treated it so lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll take him back down.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I'd appreciate the assistance. I'm afraid that, in his current state, he won't be able to walk on his own...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if we can't, we won't just leave him here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: You're right... My apologies, Traveler. I'm sure he feels bad about the situation.
He's the least of your concerns right now. You should be worried about yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! The Fatui strike again!

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: You must've already figured out why we're here.

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: We won't let you go unless you give us that sword.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No! Please, don't give them the sword.

choices.text: Of course, I wouldn't hand it over to them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's the spirit! Let's knock 'em down!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Mr. Pallad, I'll take you to a safe place! Quickly!

response.speaker: Vadim
response.text: So naive! We won't let any witness escape!

response.speaker: Vadim
response.text: This sword will make a fine gift for Her Excellency, Harbinger Signora!

choices.text: Don't even think about putting your hands on it!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Remarkable! This weapon is like no other...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: You're also extraordinary. No matter if it's your fighting stance or the momentum of your swing, it's perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You flatter me.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: This sword is special. I didn't want to go too deep into the research, and yet I couldn't take my eyes off of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon thinks that's one of your own special qualities, not the sword's...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Clearly this is a mysterious yet dangerous and enticing sword.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Mr. Albedo must have great confidence in you to have entrusted you with such an important item.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you've earned his trust with your abilities.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I agree with Paimon.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: However, the sword hadn't absorbed much energy before it was handed to you... Huh, how did Mr. Albedo recognize its uniqueness among a pile of other items in storage?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A flash of brilliance often doesn't make sense. For example, Paimon's appetite for Sticky Honey Roast!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah... Which reminds me, I didn't eat much today.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I went looking for you right after completing my experiment. Then, on the way, I ran into an adventurer trapped in the snow. I spent quite some time saving him...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: *rumbling*

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did your stomach just rumble?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah... Ahhhh! N—No, it's not like that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be so shy! Just say what's on your mind!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Um, um...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon help you out: Paimon's hungry! We should grab something to eat!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm... I'm hungry. I could really go for a...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Oh... ah... I'm just a little embarassed...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nothing to be ashamed of! Admitting that you're hungry makes the food taste better.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Huh, is that so?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! Let's get moving! There must be some food back at the camp.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It'd be lovely to have some Sticky Honey Roast to keep us warm in this icy weather.

choices.text: I'm grateful for the faith he puts in me.

talks.objective: Follow Sucrose to the adventurer camp

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The dragon's power... the dragon's life force can revive withered plants and empower them to such a degree...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Inconceivable!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How could a dead tree stump turn out to be such a monster!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon almost got swallowed!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, why hasn't anything like that happened before?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Most probably it's because the sword fell to the ground. The impact must've caused its power to leak out.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: It's my fault! Don't make me leave! I beg you!

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I promise I'll stay put!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ah, Mr. Pallad... There's no need to go into a fetal position...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This Cryo Regisvine having originally withered up and died here... Is it because it hadn't been able to absorb the ambient corruption?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: After you purified the corruption, the resulting pure elemental energy not only revived it, but also enhanced it.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Pure life force will cause it to constantly regenerate itself... together with its fighting spirit.

choices.text: The situation looks worse than expected...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I also haven't encountered any similar incidents.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Yet I must admit that a phenomenon of this rarity, although unexpected, is a valuable discovery.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Sucrose.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah, yes!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Keep an eye on that adventurer. Take him back to the camp.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yes sir!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: As for the matters at hand, I beg your pardon, Traveler... but I must ask for your further assistance.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll do what I can to help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Such an unexpected mess, and we're the only ones who can clean it up. *sigh* It must be because we keep outdoing ourselves!

choices.text: I wouldn't have expected that. Is it because I'm too powerful?

talks.objective: Defeat the Fatui who have come to take the sword

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I heard the ruckus and came over to check. So it was you who made all this noise.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What happened? Did you get into a fight?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: M—Mr. Albedo... I—I didn't mean to...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Aren't you supposed to be organizing documents? Why did you come here all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: And you got into a fight with such a dangerous opponent — in this terrain...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I—I also got into a fight, I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well now even Paimon feels guilty...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Uh... Ah... I only... I'm sorry, I was just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Huh, I reckon you've been led astray by yet another thing that attracted your attention.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I told Sucrose about the sword, my bad.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You told her everything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just told her about the sword's properties and origin. We didn't let her touch it! We know better than that.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: *sigh* Never mind. We couldn't have kept her in the dark for too long anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Sucrose is naturally drawn to obscure knowledge and mystery. She is great alchemist material, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ah... Uh... I promise I won't be causing trouble anymore. I swear on the quadruple-size Sweet Flower seeds I just propagated!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's not trouble that worries me, I'm only concerned with your safety. You must be more careful next time.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: *sigh* Anyway, what's going on with that adventurer crouching over there?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I took it upon myself to protect Mr. Pallad during the battle. He should be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I'm... I'm freezing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He must've caught a cold during the fight.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ahhhh, I didn't consider that possibility... It's my oversight, my apologies!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Mr. Albedo, I'll check on him!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose may seem a bit rigid, but she's a good kid with a heart of gold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call her a kid if I were your size.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can't disagree.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That girl... Let her out of your sight, and she winds up in the strangest places...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't that just what young people do in general?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: True.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sucrose didn't mean to cause trouble. Don't be too hard on her.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm not angry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? There seems to be a shiny thingy on the sword.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Huh? Another change...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The sword's power is much stronger than before. How did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We fought with Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There were some ferocious characters among those Fatui soldiers. We've never seen them before.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: So it's the energy it's never encountered before...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It caused the sword to greatly grow in strength.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Aim for those ice pillars!

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Ahhhh!? Wh—What is it!?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: In position! Prepare for battle!
